purpose: Freeze an ACE-specific intervention that separates exact state conservation from reunion timing without mislabeling the released BulletpointAnalyzer as a clean native positive control.

scientific_primitive.representation_unit: ACE playbook bullet [id] helpful=h harmful=d :: content
scientific_primitive.semantic_equivalence_for_primary_probe: exact content equality only; no embedding threshold or approximate semantic grouping
scientific_primitive.sufficient_state_hypothesis: For an intervention whose target state is additive credit, exact-clone reunion must preserve content and set helpful=sum_i helpful_i and harmful=sum_i harmful_i mechanically.
scientific_primitive.timing_hypothesis: State-preserving reunion can only protect an operator if reunion occurs before that operator consumes the fragmented state. Post-Curator reunion cannot retroactively change the same Curator decision.

frozen_exact_clone_witness.canonical: [str-00001] helpful=6 harmful=2 :: Verify all constraints before committing the answer.
split: [str-00001] helpful=3 harmful=1 :: Verify all constraints before committing the answer.
[str-00002] helpful=3 harmful=1 :: Verify all constraints before committing the answer.
frozen_exact_clone_witness.identity_placebo: [str-00999] helpful=6 harmful=2 :: Verify all constraints before committing the answer.

A_native_analyzer_off.state_after_curator_before_post_generati: unchanged by analyzer because analyzer is disabled

B_native_analyzer_on.state_after_curator_before_post_generati: may be reunited by the released embedding+LLM analyzer
B_native_analyzer_on.critical_boundary: LLM-mediated content and returned counters are not mechanically forced to preserve the programmatically computed sums; this arm is not the primary sufficient-state proof

C_stri_deterministic_post_curator_reunio.repair_timing: after the Curator decision and before post-curator generation
C_stri_deterministic_post_curator_reunio.repair_operator: keep the first canonical content/ID and mechanically sum h and d; no LLM merge
C_stri_deterministic_post_curator_reunio.prediction: restores additive state for post-curator generation and future samples but cannot repair the current Curator decision

D_stri_deterministic_pre_curator_reunion.state_at_curator: one exact canonical-content bullet with h=6,d=2
D_stri_deterministic_pre_curator_reunion.repair_timing: immediately after Reflector counter update and before Curator
D_stri_deterministic_pre_curator_reunion.repair_operator: keep the first canonical content/ID and mechanically sum h and d; no LLM merge
D_stri_deterministic_pre_curator_reunion.prediction: is the theory-matched sufficient-state repair for any Curator effect caused by exact-clone counter fragmentation, while any remaining difference is model/label/content sensitivity rather than lost additive credit

E_id_placebo.state_at_curator: one bullet with identical content and h=6,d=2 but a different ID token
E_id_placebo.prediction: tests model-visible ID-token sensitivity separately from multiplicity fragmentation; it is not required to produce identical LLM output

primary_zero_provider_endpoints: exact parse/format round-trip for the pinned ACE bullet syntax
aggregate helpful/harmful conservation under deterministic exact-clone reunion
canonical and pre-Curator repaired state are identical at the content+credit sufficient-state level
post-Curator repair leaves the current Curator input fragmented by construction
no approximate semantic matching and no LLM call are used in the mechanism probe

future_model_endpoint_if_separately_auth.primary: Curator proposal/output under frozen canonical, split, deterministic pre-Curator reunion, and ID-placebo inputs with matched model/runtime sampling
future_model_endpoint_if_separately_auth.claim_rule: A model-mediated difference can corroborate representation sensitivity, but ACE has no deterministic counter-only decision seam; do not overstate it as a threshold-gate analogue of Skill-Pro.
